note: All sources, references and outputs are FICTIONAL and authored by hand, except F21 (a pinned frozen R15 fictional control). Quotes are [text, occurrence] (occurrence counts overlapping exact substring matches, 1-based); check.py resolves them to explicit codepoint offsets in cases.json. Expected judgments were written by hand from ADJUDICATION-SPEC.md, not generated by the scorer. gold=true cases are adjudicator gold packets (one consistent mapping per packet); gold=false cases are scorer mutation tests that deliberately supply a wrong mapping and are never shown to adjudicators.
